Name: YouTube Streaming
Description: Stream YouTube videos as Jellyfin Series without downloading them. Uses .strm files + local stream proxy + yt-dlp.
Overview: Add YouTube channels and stream their videos directly as Series in Jellyfin.

Versions.Changelog: Initial scaffold: plugin entry point, configuration page, SQLite store, channel sync skeleton, .strm generator, stream proxy skeleton, watched tracker. Not yet feature-complete - iteration 1.
